title: bidens oblonga
intro: Bidens oblonga, commonly known as Bidens alba or "Beggar's Buttons," is a flowering plant species belonging to the aster family. The plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various ailments, with its health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Bidens oblonga are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential remedy for infections and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
